traces_to: Law 3: a file two boxes write from one source has to be the same bytes, measured; Law 4: the line ending is enforced by the write, not by the shell happening to tolerate CRLF.
how:
Add newline='
' to reseal.py:959 (dest.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')) and to his_case_never_bites.py:77 (p.write_text(...)). Red-first proofs: install_hook into a scratch git repo and assert the installed bytes hold no CR and equal the tracked source with line endings normalised; _stub a script into a scratch dir and assert no CR. No change to the door, the other writers or the 1163 proof calls.
